side.notes: Exact Betta photographs and the halfmoon standard show a sloping forehead, upturned terminal lips, an eye seated in the head, rear-set dorsal, long anal base, narrow pelvic fins and a continuous dorsal-caudal-anal envelope.

top.uncertainty: Medium. The photograph is genuinely from above but not orthographic, so it supports taper direction rather than calibrated width.
top.notes: The top-oblique live-fish photograph supports a streamlined anterior taper and narrow caudal-peduncle transition. Numeric width remains an explicitly inferred source value.

front.notes: The exact frontal Betta photograph shows laterally seated eyes, a compressed head, an upturned mouth and paired narrow pelvic fins.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: sloping forehead, tapered snout and projecting upturned lips
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: A new forehead station breaks the rejected capsule outline. The optional independent lip controls now provide a raised forward terminal mouth without requiring shared-plan changes.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: seated lateral eye within the head contour
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Reduced radius and protrusion plus full surface seating replace the rejected bead-like eye silhouette.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: rear-set dorsal, long anal and capital-D-like halfmoon caudal envelope
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The dorsal origin moves rearward, the anal base and posterior region lengthen, and equal expanded caudal spans with low rounding target the continuous halfmoon outline.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: narrow pointed pelvic fins with distal soft-ray reach
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The shared optional distal-filament control is now used with a narrow sheet root, resolving the prior broad-blade source limitation while retaining a lightweight fin mesh.

proportions.name: maximum adult total length
proportions.notes: FishBase reports 6.5 cm maximum total length; the package records that value directly while selecting one domestic male fin form.

proportions.name: maximum body depth divided by station-defined body length
proportions.uncertainty: Medium. The value is computed from the declarative target stations and checked qualitatively against uncalibrated lateral photographs, not measured from a preserved specimen.
proportions.notes: The target retains an elongate compressed Betta body without the rejected anterior capsule fullness.

proportions.name: maximum body width divided by maximum body depth
proportions.uncertainty: Medium to high. One top source is oblique and the frontal source is not dimensionally calibrated, so the ratio is a conservative compressed-body target rather than an observed measurement.
proportions.notes: The revised anterior half-width no longer exceeds the midbody and tapers through head, forehead and snout.

proportions.name: halfmoon caudal vertical span divided by total length
proportions.uncertainty: Medium. The IBC defines the 180-degree envelope, but the declarative span ratio is a source target checked against an uncalibrated photograph rather than a published morphometric measurement.
proportions.notes: Equal 19.5 mm upper and lower spans create a 39 mm vertical envelope against the 65 mm total-length reference.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: coherent blue-green metallic flank without pale camouflage islands
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Scale-row relief and fine low-amplitude variation now drive a continuous cobalt-to-turquoise sheen. The rejected broad thresholded FBM patches are removed. Exact RGB is not sampled from either photograph.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: dark face and dorsum framing the iridescent flank
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Smooth anatomical gradients darken the face and dorsum without inventing a hard-edged body patch.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: blue proximal to red distal median-fin field
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: A broad smooth distal transition and ray modulation replace the thin neon rim of the rejected candidate while preserving translucent fin membranes. Hue placement is qualitative because domestic colour and camera response vary.

previousCandidates.notes: The preserved fable-v1 candidate was rejected for its capsule snout, bead-like eyes, forward oversized dorsal, rounded delta-like caudal, broad pelvic blades, pale camouflage-like flank islands and excess anterior width.

reviewedCandidate.notes: Independent three-view review found the repaired halfmoon silhouette, seated eyes, upturned lips, rear-set dorsal, long anal base, broader capital-D-like caudal, narrow pelvic reach and coherent blue-red surface suitable for explicit user review. This receipt is not user acceptance and does not authorize promotion. Residual planar fin construction, animation appearance, capsule-like surface smoothness, and inferred top and front proportions remain caveats for the user gate.

mismatches.note: The preserved fable-v1 candidate remains rejected for its capsule snout, bead-like eyes, forward oversized dorsal, rounded delta-like caudal, broad pelvic blades and excess anterior width. Fable-v2 materially repairs those failures and does not replace the preserved rejection record.

The preserved fable-v1 body has broad pale turquoise procedural islands and neon red fin rims. Fable-v2 replaces those with coherent fine scale sheen and a broad blue-to-red fin transition tied to the exact blue-red halfmoon reference page.

The median and paired fins retain game-scale planar membrane construction with normal-map ray relief. Their silhouettes are materially improved, but they do not reproduce individually modeled soft-ray curvature or full membrane volume.

The revised head and body stations remove the worst capsule proportions, but the shared procedural body surface remains smoother and more uniformly inflated than a fully sculpted real Betta under close inspection.
Recorded technical animation validation passed, but the complete idle, swim and display clips have not been explicitly accepted for perceptual naturalism, fin drag, or soft-ray motion.

Body width and frontal head shape remain medium-to-high uncertainty because the verified top photograph is oblique and neither top nor front source is dimensionally calibrated. Fable-v2 must not be represented as an orthographically measured reconstruction.
